label: ACCEPT
reason: Every codemod default-exports createTransformer(...) (move-maxsteps-to-stopwhen.ts, rename-core-message-to-model-message.ts) or a lib factory that returns one (remove-openai-facade.ts via removeFacade); the listed lib entries are the definition and its factories/helpers, so nothing is left to count. jscodeshift (run via -t in src/lib/transform.ts) accepts a raw (fileInfo, api) transformer, and neither tsconfig nor .oxlintrc.json checks this, so a codemod hand-rolling the j(source)/hasChanges/toSource boilerplate would slip through and is worth flagging as drift from the shared helper.
